task.name: Phase 3: Configuration & Installation
task.description: Build CLI, install globally, migrate credentials
task.action:
1. Create config directory: mkdir -p ~/.google-ads-cli
2. Migrate credentials: cp ~/.openclaw-backup/skills/google-ads-pro/config/credentials.json ~/.google-ads-cli/config.json
3. Build TypeScript: npm run build # Creates dist/ directory with compiled JS
4. Install globally: npm link # Creates symlink: /usr/local/bin/google-ads-cli -> ~/google-ads-cli/dist/index.js
5. Verify installation: which google-ads-cli google-ads-cli --version google-ads-cli --help
task.verify: - ~/.google-ads-cli/config.json exists with credentials - dist/ directory populated with compiled JavaScript - which google-ads-cli returns path - google-ads-cli --version responds - google-ads-cli --help shows all 5 commands - Symlink in /usr/local/bin/ points correctly
task.done: - CLI built and installed globally - Credentials migrated - CLI accessible from any directory - Ready for OpenClaw integration
